body:
Track 5 (simdesign) next step of `simdesign-webbuckle`/`simdesign-webshell`: replaces the w/b ≤ 8 rule of the laser-cut bracket with a lateral-torsional buckling factor ≥ 3 and reruns the optimiser.

Result (stylised, preliminary): the old rule forces the 2 mm gauge (35.8–36.0 g); the buckling guard allows 1.5 mm at w ≈ 18.7 mm (31.1–31.4 g, ~12% lighter). The guard does not bind at that optimum; no feasible 1.5 mm design found for K ≥ 5.

- 7 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok (441 projects).
- Note: `guards.txt` was produced just before a small fix that treats NaN factors (b ≥ w) as a violation; it does not affect the reported optima.
- Run line appended to `prompts/runs.jsonl`.
